## Enterprise Cloud Cost Optimization

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, DOcplex

- Developed a prototype to optimise cloud-resource utilisation and operating costs, taking workloads, VM capacities, and SLA requirements into account.
- Developed and evaluated a rolling-horizon approach to compare scheduling strategies based on VM utilisation, SLA violations, and total operating costs.

## AI Infrastructure Startup Analysis — Schwarz Project Study

**Tools:** Excel; Python, Pandas, and Jupyter Notebook for supplementary data collection and cleaning

- Analysed and classified European start-ups in AI infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, and MLOps to identify companies potentially relevant for investments, partnerships, and internal benchmarking.
- Structured company data in Excel by technology area, funding stage, use case, and strategic relevance to support portfolio screening and further analysis.

## AI-Based Meeting-Room Search & Booking

**Tools:** LLM applications, Python, JavaScript, Vue.js

- Developed an LLM-based prototype for meeting-room search and recommendation, translating natural-language requests into structured requirements such as capacity, equipment, location, and time.
- Implemented request interpretation, room matching, and booking logic in a working application prototype.

## Crime Atlas

**Technologies:** Vue 3, TypeScript, Kotlin, Ktor, PostgreSQL, ECharts

- Developed an interactive US crime analysis prototype featuring state-level mapping, city search, offense and time filters, trend analysis, seasonality analysis, and six-month baseline forecasting.
- Implemented a layered full-stack architecture with a Vue frontend, Kotlin/Ktor backend, and PostgreSQL-based data storage and caching.

> The public demo uses deterministic synthetic observations and does not represent actual US crime statistics.
